text:
Anna: Quick idea from design review — add an inline 'Preview' in run history so QA can inspect tool outputs without re-running. Mock: https://redwood.in/s/preview-inline
Sam: Inline expand > modal. Keeps context.
Rui: Agree, inline collapsible row. Also we must snapshot outputs at run-time so preview is stable.
Maya: Need a badge for side-effecting vs read-only calls. QA can't accidentally re-run side-effects.
Anna: Proposed: chevron 'Preview' expands a small panel with tabs: Inputs | Structured output | Schema. CTA: 'Handoff to QA'.
Sam: Copy nit: maybe 'Send to QA' feels lighter. We'll A/B.
Maya: A11y: on expand, move focus to close button, set aria-expanded, use aria-live for streamed output.
Nick: Perf: virtualize the structured tree for big JSONs.
Rui: I'll add /snapshots endpoint and persist outputs 90d. Expose snapshot id in run metadata.
Anna: Also show a 1-line collapsed summary: "Output: ok — 3 keys — schema valid" for fast triage.
qa-bot: Created ticket #234: run-history: inline preview + snapshot https://redwood.in/t/234
Anna: I'll update Figma with annotations and a11y notes. Sam please drop copy variants.
Sam: Will do. :thumbsup:
